title: Clinical and Longitudinal Reanalysis of Peripheral Blood Transcription after Spinal Cord Injury — code and supporting data
description: Source scripts, reused public-study inputs, metadata curation, fixed signatures and BTM definitions, complete retained model families, reference outputs, a portable reproduction entry point and numerical validation. These are exploratory secondary analyses. The withdrawn LASSO and supervised postselection-permutation claims are not reinstated.
